_comment: Tolerances for `tools/logcmp.py` on the stock-vs-Flash-1 comparison
(docs/06_patch_pipeline.md section 7). Flash 1 changes NOTHING the engine
can see, so every number below is pure run-to-run repeatability of the bench
scenario in procedure.md - not a budget the patch is allowed to spend.
The variables are the stock ones of issue #44, named as in re/symbols.csv;
the FR name and the scaling are in the per-variable comments there. Log them
in the physical units of logging/README.md section 1, not in raw counts.
ff_ticks, ff_alive and ff_src_seen are deliberately NOT listed: they exist
only in the Flash-1 log, so logcmp lists them as uncompared. Do not pass
--strict to this comparison, or that alone will fail it.
These limits are a STARTING POINT derived from the signals' idle behaviour,
not from two recorded runs. Record two stock runs of the same scenario first
and tighten every line to what the ECU actually repeats (docs/05 E0 test);
a tolerance wider than the repeatability proves nothing.

prist_w._unit: bar, 0.005/LSB, 0x8031DA; rail control ripple at idle dominates
